comparison.objective: Make five flat sanding passes along a plywood edge; candidate tunes and locks an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained flat abrasive contact and reciprocation versus recessed-tool insertion, fine collar rotation, torque-limited locking, and impact-cycle diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Five full passes while flat without workpiece slip versus two dynamically acceptable stops without bottoming, rebound, overload, or drift. No separate spec version is provided.
comparison.reason: Surface finishing does not test adjustment retention or dynamic energy absorption.
